title: Bill Credit Amounts on Beacon Ridge Business Plans
content:
Small Business Electricity Supply plans carry three kinds of bill credit: the sign-up credit, the renewal loyalty credit and the multi-site credit. This schedule fixes the plan figures for each.

## Sign-up credit

| Plan | Sign-up credit per site | Completed cycles of continuous supply before it posts | Forfeited if the agreement leaves active status before qualifying | Earned on a broker enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 0.00 USD (none) | 0 | yes | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 100.00 USD | 3 | yes | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 150.00 USD | 3 | yes | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 200.00 USD | 3 | yes | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 150.00 USD | 3 | yes | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 200.00 USD | 3 | yes | no |

The sign-up credit is a one-time bill credit per site; 0.00 means the plan carries none.

## Renewal loyalty credit

| Plan | Renewal loyalty credit |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 0.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 50.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 75.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 100.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 75.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 100.00 USD |

The renewal loyalty credit is the plan's one-time bill credit associated with an explicit acceptance of a renewal offer.

## Multi-site credit

| Plan | Multi-site credit per site per billing cycle | Minimum number of the business's sites active on small business plans |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 0.00 USD | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 5.00 USD | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 7.50 USD | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 10.00 USD | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 7.50 USD | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 10.00 USD | 3 |

The multi-site credit is a bill credit per site per billing cycle when the multi-site minimum is met; the minimum is 3 sites on every plan.

## Reading the schedule

- Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable carries a 0.00 figure for all three credits.
- The 24-month plans (Fixed 24 and Green 24) share the same figures, as do the 36-month plans (Fixed 36 and Green 36).
- Hypothetical comparison: of two sites of the same business, one on Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 and one on Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36, the plan figure for the multi-site credit is 5.00 USD for the first and 10.00 USD for the second, because each site's figure is read from its own plan.
